title: Misato decides a topic change on the first turn of an answer
goal: Correct the recorded real-model topic-change failure in NERV's prompting, with deterministic tests for the prompt and control flow and an owner-approved real-model run as competence evidence
acceptance: Committed tests fail before the fix: the answer turn names its pending question and original request, and the system prompt ends with the topic decision
Prompts of every turn without clarification stay byte-identical
The owner-approved gemma4:12b run returns newRequest on the topic-change cases and still plans continuations; failures are recorded, never hidden
privacy: Neutral invented cases only; local loopback model, no cloud route or credentials
validation: Independent review before the parent closes
escalation: Real-model runs only within the owner-approved budget
Never weaken or delete a case to make an evaluation pass
